summary: Single agent audits all chosen files for resilience defects

result.report:
app/payments/PaymentClient.scala:16 | unbounded-retry | high | chargeWithRetry recovers from any Throwable (line 20) and recurses with no attempt cap or backoff (line 22).
app/payments/PaymentClient.scala:17 | missing-timeout | high | The charge POST sets no request timeout, unlike refundStatus which sets withRequestTimeout at line 27.
app/payments/PaymentClient.scala:17 | missing-idempotency | high | The charge POST at lines 17-18 sends no idempotency key and is retried on any failure, so a retry can double-charge.
app/payments/PaymentClient.scala:19 | swallowed-error | med | `.map(_.json)` never checks the HTTP status, so 4xx/5xx responses count as success and body parse failures are retried.
app/orders/OrderService.scala:12 | blocking-in-future | high | Await.result(payments.charge(...), 30.seconds) blocks a thread of the implicit ec inside the Future body opened at line 10.
app/orders/OrderService.scala:13 | blocking-in-future | med | Thread.sleep(200) runs inside the Future body on the ec thread pool.
app/orders/OrderService.scala:15 | swallowed-exception | high | `recover { case _: Exception => None }` discards the cause with no logging, so charge failures, timeouts and JSON errors all become None.
app/orders/OrderService.scala:11 | missing-idempotency | med | repo.insert runs before the charge with no compensation when the charge fails (line 15 returns None), and a caller retry would insert a duplicate order.
src/main/java/demo/inventory/InventoryConsumer.java:12 | unbounded-pool | med | Executors.newCachedThreadPool() has no upper bound on thread count.
src/main/java/demo/inventory/InventoryConsumer.java:13 | unbounded-queue | med | LinkedBlockingQueue is created with no capacity bound.
src/main/java/demo/inventory/InventoryConsumer.java:25 | unbounded-submission | med | Every onMessage call submits another drain task (line 25) on top of the unbounded queue and pool.
src/main/java/demo/inventory/InventoryConsumer.java:33 | swallowed-exception | high | The empty catch block at lines 33-34 silently drops failed reservations, with no logging, retry or dead-letter handling.
src/main/java/demo/shipping/ShippingGateway.java:12 | missing-timeout | high | `new RestTemplate()` is built with no connect or read timeouts, so it applies to both createShipment (line 16) and trackingStatus (line 22).
src/main/java/demo/shipping/ShippingGateway.java:14 | naive-retry | high | @Retryable(maxAttempts = 10) sets no backoff and no retryFor, so every exception is retried immediately.
src/main/java/demo/shipping/ShippingGateway.java:16 | missing-idempotency | high | The carrier POST in createShipment is retried by @Retryable with no idempotency key, so retries can create duplicate shipments.
src/main/java/demo/shipping/ShippingGateway.java:22 | blocking-in-future | med | The blocking RestTemplate call runs inside CompletableFuture.supplyAsync, which uses the common ForkJoinPool by default.
src/main/java/demo/shipping/ShippingGateway.java:23 | resource-leak | med | f.get(2, SECONDS) times out but never cancels f, so the HTTP call keeps running and holding a pool thread.
TOTAL: 17
